description: Jabo Waggoner's campaign paid $60,000 to the chairman of a charity created to publish a book about the senator. The charity's board included a registered lobbyist; lobbyists bought the book at an RSA Plaza signing businesses paid for; then the IRS revoked the charity for not filing its returns and its state registration expired. Every claim cited to a public record.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Strong with Stone
title: The Book — Spencer Stone for Alabama Senate
